behavior.name: 0x13004b6c
behavior.description: A platform that orbits a bhvFerrisWheelAxle. Its world position is dynamically calculated based on the axle's current rotation and a relative angle offset determined by the 'sPlatform Index's behavior parameter, where each index represents a 90-degree (0x4000) offset.

field.name: Platform Index
field.description: Index of the platform (0-3), used to set the relative angle (multiplied by 90 degrees).
